name: Dazalar
summary: In Dolanaar, Dazalar trains young night elf hunters for the wilds of Teldrassil. He teaches them to aim true and form bonds with the beasts of the great boughs.

sections.title: The Dolanaar Encampment
sections.body: Dazalar trains young hunters in Dolanaar before they venture beyond Shadowglen. Night elf rangers and sentinels patrol the wilderness, and he teaches newcomers the patience and discipline needed to protect Teldrassil's fragile ecosystem.

sections.title: Bonding with the Wild
sections.body: Dazalar teaches hunters to tame and care for beasts. The Kaldorei seek a pact with forest predators such as nightsabers, owls, and strigid hunters, training them to fight beside their companions with respect rather than force.

faq.answer: Dazalar trains night elf hunters in Dolanaar, teaching them combat skills and how to tame wild beasts.
You can find Dazalar outdoors in Dolanaar, Teldrassil's central hub, shortly after leaving Shadowglen.
Dazalar teaches ranged attacks, traps, and survival skills. He also guides novice hunters through trials to master taming wilderness animals.

faq.q: Does Dazalar offer any special quests?
faq.answer: Yes. Dazalar offers hunter training that includes The Hunter's Path, the multi-part trial Taming the Beast, and Training the Beast. These teach young hunters to bond with and care for animal companions.

faq.q: Why do night elves rely so heavily on hunters?
faq.answer: Night elves have lived in harmony with Kalimdor's ancient forests for millennia. Archers and scouts form the backbone of the Sentinel army, using stealth, marksmanship, and animal allies to protect their lands without disrupting nature.

faq.q: What kind of beasts does Dazalar send hunters to tame?
faq.answer: Dazalar directs hunters to find native Teldrassil beasts, including local spiders, nightsabers, and birds of prey. The trials test their ability to approach and calm wild predators.

angles.text: As a hunter, Dazalar guides you through the first trials of beast mastery and caring for an animal companion.
As a night elf, you learn the traditions of the Kaldorei sentinels and scouts, and how to live in balance with nature's fierce predators.
